question: Can the exact physical-record absolute contrast of equation H12 be bounded uniformly in size in any certified square-lattice region, without replacing it by a signed or boundary-only average?
research_basis: Reuse the already proved physical connected-current path and parity-only Peierls bounds in Local Wiki thermodynamic-limits.md and connected-current-defects.md. This is an exact corollary for the H12 observable, not a new path method or a threshold fit.
frozen_model: Canonical square_graph(L), L>=3, 0<p<1, real finite h, q=(1+tanh h)/2, perfect signed interior charge, rough left/right boundary, binary right-cut logical parity, physical Bayes risk. Keep p fixed when converting to p_eff in H12.

registered_branches.charge_aware_current: For p<=1/(1+1/(2cosh h)), transfer the existing convex-current witness bound with gamma=sqrt[p(1-p)(1+sech h)] and square path-growth constant 3 to 1-A_L=2R_L.
registered_branches.parity_only_complement: For any h and r=min(p,1-p), transfer the existing Bernoulli occupancy/complement Peierls bound with beta=2sqrt[r(1-r)] and square path-growth constant 3 to the same A_L. Keep this as a separately valid comparator, especially near p=1.

geometry_and_prefactor: There are 2L rough vertices, opposite-side path length at least L-1, and at most (4/3)3^n simple n-step paths from any starting vertex. Use the conservative inherited 2b_L C geometric-series prefactor, hence 1-A_L<=32L rho^(L-1)/[3(1-rho)] whenever rho<1.
acceptance: Prove the two physical H12 corollaries and their exact scope; verify the h-to-q algebra, strict low-p root and convexity gate, plus a separate high-p complement region. State that these are old sufficient correctability certificates expressed in the new observable, not a moderate-p square phase result.
verification: Closed-form algebra and deterministic numerical checks of the strict roots at h=0,0.5 and the directed limit, and p=.98 parity complement. No new current histories, system sizes, bootstrap or threshold fitting.
claim_boundary: Only the certified low-p and high-p sufficient regions are controlled. No necessity, sharp threshold, moderate-p behavior, line-tension limit, or universality follows.
stop_rule: Stop after the two proof transfers and root checks; do not run a size scan or reinterpret the sufficient root as a critical point.
outcome: Both inherited physical path bounds transfer directly to H12. For p below the strict field-dependent low-p root, or p above the strict all-h complement root, A_L tends to one exponentially with an explicit square prefactor. The moderate-p fixed-h square problem remains open.
